cases.prompt: Write a Selenium Java test with JUnit 5 for logging in, using a page object and local Chrome.
expectations: Creates the driver in @BeforeEach and quits it in @AfterEach.
Defines a LoginPage page object with By locators.
Uses explicit waits and no Thread.sleep.
Runs against a local browser, emulator or app; it does not require a hosted cloud grid or vendor account.

cases.prompt: Write a Selenium Python test with pytest for our search page.

any.why: yields the driver from a fixture

expectations: Provides the driver from a pytest fixture with yield and quit.
Runs against a local browser, emulator or app; it does not require a hosted cloud grid or vendor account.
